basics.name: Jerome Liu
basics.label: Technical Success Manager
basics.summary: Technical Success Manager at TomTom in Shanghai. Previously Azure Technical Advisor and Support Engineer at Microsoft, and L2 Support Expert at HAI Robotics.

work.summary: CX Delivery Management, Shanghai. Technical point of contact for automotive and platform customers using TomTom navigation SDKs, Orbis map content and location APIs.
highlights: Triage and reproduce customer-reported issues across SDK, map data and services
Coordinate with product and engineering teams to drive cases to resolution

work.summary: Escalation support for warehouse-automation solutions covering software, infrastructure and robot hardware.
highlights: Handled escalations from field teams and key customers
Delivered customer-facing training on operating and maintaining HAI Robotics solutions
Led on-site support and incident response for key customers and major events

work.summary: Technical lead of the Azure support team, supporting strategic customers through pre-sales and post-sales.
highlights: Improved average case-handling efficiency by about 40% while maintaining a 4.87/5 customer satisfaction score
Owned quality control and risk management for support deliverables
Relayed customer feedback to product R&D and delivered technical training for new features

work.position: Azure Technical Support Engineer / Support Escalation Engineer
work.summary: Enterprise technical support in the Azure Developer Support team.
highlights: Specialised in Azure Storage, Azure Cache for Redis, Azure SDK, API Management and Service Fabric
Handled critical outages and escalations with product and engineering teams

portfolio.name: Maps Explorer
portfolio.description: Static single-page app that compares TomTom Orbis, TomTom Classic, Google Maps, HERE, Mapbox and OpenStreetMap side by side with one synced camera.

portfolio.name: Claude Session Manager
portfolio.description: Native macOS SwiftUI app to browse and manage local Claude Code sessions, distributed via Homebrew.
